sanskrit:
सत्त्वात्सञ्जायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च ।
प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतोऽज्ञानमेव च ॥ १४-१७॥
iast:
sattvātsañjāyate jñānaṃ rajaso lobha eva ca
pramādamohau tamaso bhavato’jñānameva ca 14-17
translation: Knowledge arises from SATTWA, greed from RAJAS, heedlessness, delusion and also ignorance arise from TAMAS.
